(1) Push down on locking arm to unlock. Then hold the

NOTICE:
Do not hold the wire harness to pull it.

back ribs

2. Connect the Connector
(1) Align the direction of locking feature in same direction
and mate the connector holding the back ribs in
straight direction.
(2) Insert it until a lock securely locks, and pull the
connector lightly after the insertion, and confirm that
a lock is enabled.
